fields.effectiveLabel: Ohio Rev. Code Sec. 2953.61 same-act charge schedule
fields.reason: REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING: paragraph 9 of this application promises a list of every charge arising from the same act, and Ohio Rev. Code Sec. 2953.61 makes that list decisive for whether the qualifying conviction can be expunged at all. The packet holds no charge list and never guesses one; the attachment schedule names it as a document the participant assembles from the certified record and files with the application.
